policy.completionRule: The implementation plan is complete when L01-L08 pass with scoped local end-to-end evidence and reviewers.

statusMeaning: Policy adopted; local completion has not yet been assessed against all eight gates. Historical slice evidence keeps its original scope.

gates.name: Setup, adoption, and export
gates.requirement: Install from pinned public SDK/tooling inputs, create and import a Swift app, build and run on both local targets, and export a working independent build. FieldLog consumes public interfaces from its separate repository. Registry publication and outside developers are not prerequisites.

gates.name: Shared app and native UI
gates.requirement: FieldLog's supported screens, state, navigation, input, accessibility, shared design, persistence, and first-party capabilities work on both local targets. Record OS-specific limitations. Physical-only services use explicit test adapters for local orchestration, with actual hardware/provider behavior pending.

gates.name: Compiler and owned runtime
gates.requirement: Supported Swift features execute in native and guest modes through the owned engine with actionable source diagnostics. Conformance, differential, malformed-input, cancellation, and resource-limit checks pass. Measure responsiveness, memory, and update size on the stated local workload. Hardware budgets remain separately unqualified.

gates.name: Safe OTA and recovery
gates.requirement: A locally served, signed logic and UI update changes both already-installed apps without reinstall. Compatibility, tenant/app identity, signatures, replay, cohorts, key rotation, and unsupported native changes are enforced. Interrupted or failed updates recover offline with saved data intact. Use development keys, never production signing credentials.

gates.name: Local platform workflow
gates.requirement: Real console, CLI, Phoenix API, PostgreSQL, Oban workers, build workers, artifact delivery, and separate development signer complete onboarding, build, logs, cancellation, update, promotion, and rollback locally. Test store request/status/error handling against documented provider fixtures. Actual uploads, store processing, provider infrastructure, and distribution remain pending.

gates.name: Free accounts and administration
gates.requirement: Free organizations can use the full testing workflow without a card, subscription, Stripe credentials, or payment service. Memberships, permissions, usage visibility, quotas, support, export, and deletion work locally. Paid plans, invoices, payment collection, paid entitlements, and purchase integrations may remain unimplemented and inactive.

gates.name: Security and local reliability
gates.requirement: Provenance, licensing notices, VM/bridge/update verification, signer separation, tenant isolation, privacy, authorization, and local fault/restore tests pass. Resolve findings that compromise the supported local workflow. Test local service/worker loss and recovery. Production SLOs, provider failover, and staffed operations are later qualification.

gates.name: FieldLog and documentation
gates.requirement: Run the complete supported FieldLog workflow through public tooling on both targets, including edit/save/close/reopen, offline queue, attachments, guest parity, OTA, rollback, and export. Exercise the applicable Section 22 recovery and real-change corpus locally. Follow installation, upgrade, recovery, and exit guides from a clean local setup. Store use, customer counts, and paid pilots are not required.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: No Patch/Skip code, generated artifacts, tests, or engine dependencies in the product; provenance/dependency review passed.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Review distributed artifacts again as required.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Owned compiler integration, UI engine, bridges, interpreter, updater, and hosted workflow are implemented and supported.
Public support matrix, limitation list, version policy, licensing/notices, and migration contract match actual behavior.
Product naming/trademarks, customer terms, privacy material, and third-party redistribution obligations are reviewed.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Trademark review, commercial terms, and production redistribution review.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: A new developer can create and locally run a shared Swift app on physical iOS and Android using public documentation.

FieldLog's required native UI, state, navigation, input, and accessibility matrix passes on both platforms. Reference screens must meet shared-theme design parity per section8.3, reviewed side by side on physical iOS/Android devices.
originalGateMapping.topic: UI, input, state, accessibility, shared design

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: The published language/runtime/capability profile passes in native and guest modes without silent feature omission.
Compiler, guest, bridge, and native failures map to actionable original-source diagnostics.
All first-party capability families in Section 9 pass their platform-specific behavior/permission tests.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Real hardware/provider qualification. Purchase implementation, including sandbox purchases, is deferred.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Existing-app migration and native-screen embedding work for an independent Swift project.
Local/exported CI can build and maintain FieldLog independently of hosted service availability.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Published registry packages and independent hosted CI.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Meaningful logic and UI updates reach already-installed binaries on both platforms without reinstalling them.
originalGateMapping.topic: Logic and UI OTA without reinstall

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Client and server reject wrong app, environment, runtime, signature, protocol, capability, size, and replayed assignment.
originalGateMapping.topic: Identity, signature, compatibility, size, replay refusal

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Interruption at every download/activation transition preserves a launchable healthy implementation.
Failed guest startup is quarantined; offline recovery works without an infinite crash loop.
Rollback preserves saved drafts, records, uploads, and compatible schema behavior; external effects are reconciled correctly.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Live external effects. Financial effects remain deferred.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Key rotation/revocation, old offline clients, and root-compromise limitations are exercised and documented.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Production key custody and compromise recovery.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Staged promotion/halt and dual-platform cohort targeting work across mixed native binary versions.
originalGateMapping.topic: Staged promotion, halt, mixed runtime cohorts

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: New native capabilities/permissions/SDKs correctly require a store build.
originalGateMapping.topic: Native changes require a new native binary

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Elixir/Oban orchestration and isolated macOS/iOS and Android builds produce signed, traceable artifacts with usable logs and debugging symbols; Cloudflare workers or recorded hosting exceptions pass resource/isolation/lifecycle qualification.
originalGateMapping.topic: Build workers, logs, provenance, development signing
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Production Cloudflare/macOS capacity, isolation, and release signing.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Store integrations reach verified ready-for-testing and available states; provider errors are accurately represented.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Actual uploads, processing, testing, approval, and availability.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: SolidJS console on Cloudflare and Phoenix API support onboarding, teams, permissions, SSO, audit export, customer keys, and dedicated-runner workflows end to end.
originalGateMapping.topic: Console/API onboarding, roles, audit, keys, runners
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Live deployment, corporate SSO, and paid dedicated capacity.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Stripe billing, Neon usage reconciliation, usage caps, credits, cancellation, export/deletion, and support workflows pass realistic account and duplicate/out-of-order webhook cases.
originalGateMapping.topic: Free accounts, usage, quotas, support, export, deletion
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Payments, subscriptions, invoices, credits/refunds, financial cancellation, and paid entitlements.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Phoenix API/CLI/SolidJS behavior agrees; domain writes and Oban enqueue are atomic; publishing and chargeable actions remain idempotent under redelivery and worker failures, including migration parity with existing Go contracts.
originalGateMapping.topic: API/CLI/console parity, atomic jobs, fenced retries

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Independent VM/bridge/update/signing/tenant-isolation review has no unresolved launch-blocking findings.
originalGateMapping.topic: Independent security review and resolved findings

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Applicable standards-profile conformance, differential tests, fuzzing, and resource-limit tests pass.
Performance, memory, patch size, sharing, and real-change OTA coverage meet the approved budgets with published methodology.
originalGateMapping.topic: Local performance, memory, size, sharing, change corpus
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Hardware budgets, fleet performance, and commercial SLO claims.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Device/OS/accessibility/localization matrix passes, with physical evidence for performance and native capabilities.
Service objectives have sufficient operating/load-test evidence, including Cloudflare container stop/wake with no user traffic and Neon/Oban reconnect behavior; low-volume uncertainty is disclosed.
originalGateMapping.topic: Local load, idle jobs, restart, reconnect, recovery
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Cloudflare/Neon lifecycle and sustained production service objectives.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Neon backup restoration/region-loss, R2/CDN isolation/freshness, separate worker/signer loss, Stripe reconciliation, compromised publisher, and bad-release drills are complete.
originalGateMapping.topic: Local restore, cache isolation, worker/signer loss, publisher compromise
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Managed-provider failover, region loss, and payment reconciliation.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Alerting, accountable escalation, status page, incident communication, and security response are configured and rehearsed.
originalGateMapping.topic: Local test alerts and incident/security runbooks
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Staffed escalation, live status service, customer communication.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: D0–D8 complete; FieldLog is available through real iOS/Android store distribution with transparent update behavior.
originalGateMapping.topic: FieldLog local adoption and integrated workflow

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: FieldLog has repeated real production use, a reviewed 20-change OTA coverage corpus, and verified recovery across the required scenarios.
Two independently authored external apps qualify, including an existing Swift app migration.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Two independently authored external customer apps.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Documentation and onboarding have been tested by developers outside the engine team.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Onboarding by developers outside the engine team.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Paid-pilot evidence and contribution-margin model support the commercial offering; weak demand is explicitly reviewed.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Entirely deferred. No paid pilot, revenue, or margin threshold blocks the plan or free early launch.

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: SDK upgrade, native release, OTA release, rollback, and customer-exit guides are complete and exercised.
originalGateMapping.topic: SDK upgrade, build, OTA, rollback, exit guides

originalGateMapping.originalRequirement: Every failed/blocked mandatory item is resolved; release approval references actual evidence rather than planned work.
originalGateMapping.laterQualification: Separate authorization and applicable checks for each launch.

externalBoundaryRule: Fixtures may replace unavailable external store, payment, hardware, or push boundaries only. The owned engine and integrated local services require actual execution. Record substitutions and pending real qualification.
paymentPolicy: Free testing and early launch require no card, subscription, Stripe credentials, payment service, or paid entitlement. Payment and purchase implementation and activation may remain deferred. Preserve existing billing code and evidence.
